turns.prompt_text: Where can I watch the new Malcolm in the Middle?
turns.response_html:
The new limited revival, Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair, was released just last month on April 10, 2026.

You can find all four episodes on the following platforms:

  • Hulu: This is the primary streaming home for the revival in the United States.
  • Disney+: If you have the Disney bundle (Hulu on Disney+), you can watch it there as well. For viewers outside the U.S., it is available globally on Disney+.

What to Expect

The revival catches up with the family nearly 20 years later. The story centers on Malcolm, who is now a father to a teenage daughter named Leah, as he is dragged back into the family chaos for Hal and Lois’s 40th wedding anniversary.

Most of the original cast returned, including Frankie Muniz, Bryan Cranston, and Jane Kaczmarek. One notable change is the role of Dewey, who was recast with Caleb Ellsworth-Clark after Erik Per Sullivan declined to return to acting.

If you're looking to refresh your memory before diving into the new episodes, all 151 episodes of the original series are also currently streaming on both Hulu and Disney+.
